pdf.js 5.6.205 (Apache-2.0), unmodified build files from the pdfjs-dist npm package.
Used only to read the text of digital PDFs in the browser (ui/views/pdf-text.js).
Update: npm pack pdfjs-dist, copy legacy/build/ (the legacy build runs on older phone browsers) pdf.min.mjs and build/pdf.worker.min.mjs here.
